prompt: Compose an original complete 30-second instrumental cue for witty tactile miniature mechanisms. Instruments: pizzicato cello, bass clarinet, woodblock. 116 BPM in 4/4. Motif: an offbeat three-note arch and held answer. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: A playful and light orchestral piece featuring prominent woodwinds and pizzicato strings, creating a whimsical and slightly comedic atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首活泼轻快的管弦乐曲，以突出的木管乐器和拨弦乐器为主，营造出异想天开且略带喜剧色彩的氛围。
